name: CTIS_search_trials
description: Search EU CTIS with strict, recoverable one-based pagination. Returns exact total_records plus has_more and next_page; continue with the same query and limit while has_more is true. Records preserve CT number, full and short titles, status, conditions, investigational products, primary and other endpoints, phase, sponsor, countries, age criteria, enrollment, decision dates, results availability, and publication/update dates. No API key required.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-100. Defaults to 10; invalid values are rejected rather than silently clamped.

page.description: One-based CTIS page number. Defaults to 1; use metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true.

status.description: Trial status as a CODE on the search endpoint, e.g. 5 -- not the word that CTIS_get_trial returns.

phase.description: Phase in words, e.g. 'Therapeutic confirmatory  (Phase III)'.

conditions.description: The conditions studied, as one string.

sponsor_type.description: What kind of sponsor, e.g. 'Pharmaceutical company'.

products.description: The products, comma-separated in ONE string, e.g. 'GOSERELIN, RIBOCICLIB, EXEMESTANE'. Not a list.

endpoints.description: All endpoints run together in one string.

gender.description: Which sexes are eligible, e.g. 'Female, Male'.

age_group.description: Age bands eligible, e.g. '18-64 years, 65+ years'.

countries.description: Recruiting countries with their site counts, each as 'Country:N' in ONE string, e.g. 'Portugal:5'. Split on ':' to get the count.

trial_region.description: Region code -- 3 means inside and outside the Union.

decision_date.description: The decision dates per country in ONE string, e.g. 'DE: 11/06/2025, PT: 20/06/2025'. Dates are DD/MM/YYYY on this endpoint.

last_publication_update.description: When the public record was last republished, 'DD/MM/YYYY'. Later than last_updated when a change took time to publish.

results_first_received.description: Whether results have been posted, e.g. 'No'. A trial years past its end date with 'No' here has not reported.

name: CTIS_search_trials_filtered
description: Structured (filtered) search of the EU Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) — the European clinical-trials register under the Clinical Trials Regulation. Unlike the free-text CTIS_search_trials, this narrows results with registry filters: medical condition, trial status code, trial phase code, age group code, gender code, has-results flag, sponsor name, therapeutic area, and country/member-state-concerned (MSC) or trial region. Combine filters to count and list precisely matching authorized EU/EEA trials. 'status' takes CTIS numeric status codes only (free text such as 'ongoing' is rejected): 1=Under evaluation, 2/3/4/5=Authorised (CTIS reports all four as sub-states of 'Authorised'), 6=Halted, 7=Suspended, 8=Ended, 9=Expired, 10=Revoked, 11=Not authorised, 12=Cancelled. Phase codes are strings like '1','2','3','4'. Age group codes: '1'=in utero, '2'=preterm/newborn through children, '3'=adults, '4'=elderly (use the CTIS public portal facet for exact codes). No API key required. Pagination is strict and one-based: returns exact total_records plus has_more and next_page; continue with identical filters and limit. Records preserve products, endpoints, detailed dates and age fields.

query.description: Optional free-text term applied as CTIS 'containAll' (e.g. 'cancer', 'pembrolizumab'). Combine with structured filters below.

medical_condition.description: Medical condition / indication filter, e.g. 'breast cancer', 'leukemia'.

status.description: CTIS numeric trial status code(s) -- NOT free text. Accepts a single code or a list. Valid codes: 1=Under evaluation, 2/3/4/5=Authorised (CTIS reports these four as sub-states of 'Authorised' and publishes no finer label), 6=Halted, 7=Suspended, 8=Ended, 9=Expired, 10=Revoked, 11=Not authorised, 12=Cancelled. Example: [3] or [3, 4]. Any other value is rejected with an error rather than silently returning zero trials.

trial_phase_code.description: Trial phase code(s) as strings, e.g. ['3'] for Phase III. Accepts a single value or a list.

age_group_code.description: Age group code(s) as strings, e.g. ['2']. Accepts a single value or a list.

gender_code.description: Gender code(s) as strings. Accepts a single value or a list.

therapeutic_area.description: Therapeutic area code(s). Accepts a single value or a list.

has_study_results.description: If true, return only trials that have posted study results.

sponsor_type_code.description: Sponsor type code(s). Accepts a single value or a list.

country.description: Member State Concerned (MSC) country code(s). Accepts a single value or a list (alias for msc).

msc.description: Member State Concerned (MSC) code(s). Accepts a single value or a list.

trial_region_code.description: Trial region code(s) (e.g. EU/EEA vs partly outside). Accepts a single value or a list.

sort_by.description: Optional CTIS sort key (e.g. by decision date).

page.description: One-based CTIS page number. Defaults to 1; use metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true.

sponsor_type.description: What kind of sponsor, e.g. 'Pharmaceutical company'.

endpoints.description: All endpoints run together in one string.

gender.description: Which sexes are eligible, e.g. 'Female, Male'.

age_group.description: Age bands eligible, e.g. '18-64 years, 65+ years'.

countries.description: Recruiting countries with their site counts, each as 'Country:N' in ONE string, e.g. 'Portugal:5'. Split on ':' to get the count.

trial_region.description: Region code -- 3 means inside and outside the Union.

decision_date.description: The decision dates per country in ONE string, e.g. 'DE: 11/06/2025, PT: 20/06/2025'. Dates are DD/MM/YYYY on this endpoint.

last_publication_update.description: When the public record was last republished, 'DD/MM/YYYY'. Later than last_updated when a change took time to publish.

name: CTIS_get_trial
description: Retrieve complete top-level public CTIS trial metadata by CT number, including human-readable and coded status/region, key dates, authorized Part I/II application details, member states, events, results, corrective measures, and the full public document manifest (protocol and other publication files with UUID/type/version metadata). No API key required.

ct_number.description: The EU CT number, e.g. '2022-503001-38-01'. The last two digits are the application version, so two CT numbers differing only there are the same trial.

decision_date.description: When the overall decision was taken.

start_date_eu.description: When the trial started in the Union.

publish_date.description: When this record was published to the public register.

trial_region.description: Where the trial runs, e.g. 'Both' for inside and outside the Union.

documents.description: The public documents attached to the trial -- protocol, participant information, the decision letters. `documentTypeLabel` says which.

uuid.description: Document UUID, which is how it is fetched.

documentTypeLabel.description: The type in words, e.g. 'Protocol (for publication)'.

systemVersion.description: CTIS's version counter for the file.

associatedEntityId.description: Which part of the dossier the document belongs to.

events.description: Notifications the sponsor filed, per member state.

trialEvents.description: One entry per member state, with the notifications filed there. The same event can be filed on different dates in different states.

notificationType.description: What was notified, e.g. 'START_OF_TRIAL', 'END_OF_TRIAL', 'TEMPORARY_HALT'. A temporary halt is a safety signal the status field may not show.

authorized_application.description: The authorised application itself, as the regulation structures it.

eudraCt.description: Whether the trial came across from the old EudraCT register.

isTransitioned.description: True when it was transitioned from EudraCT. A transitioned trial's early history lives in the old register, not here.

memberStatesConcerned.description: The member states the application was submitted to, with their decision dates.

lastDecisionDate.description: Its most recent decision. A later date than firstDecisionDate means the authorisation was amended.

authorizedPartI.description: Part I of the application: the science and the product, assessed ONCE for the whole Union by the Reporting Member State.

id.description: CTIS id of the Part I record.

rowSubjectCount.description: Subjects planned OUTSIDE the Union ('rest of world'), e.g. 1363. The Union figure is in each member state's own record, so a global total needs both.

rowCountriesInfo.description: The non-Union countries the trial also runs in.

current.description: True when the country is still part of the trial.

medicalConditions.description: The conditions studied, at Part I level.

isConditionRareDisease.description: True when it is a rare disease.

therapeuticAreas.description: The therapeutic areas, as MeSH-style labels.

partOneTherapeuticAreas.description: The same areas as recorded against Part I.

sponsors.description: The sponsors, with their organisations, addresses, contacts and delegated third parties.

id.description: CTIS id of the sponsor record.

primary.description: True for the primary sponsor. A trial can have several sponsors and only one is primary.

isCommercial.description: True when the sponsor is commercial.

organisation.description: The organisation itself, as registered in CTIS's organisation registry.

businessKey.description: CTIS's stable organisation key, e.g. 'ORG-100003908'. This, not `id`, is what identifies the same body across trials.

type.description: What kind of body it is, e.g. 'Pharmaceutical company', 'Hospital/Clinic/Other health care facility'.

commercial.description: True when the organisation is commercial. A commercial sponsor of a trial of its own product is the competing interest the register states plainly.

isBusinessKeyValidated.description: True when the business key has been validated. An unvalidated key may not match the same organisation elsewhere.

id.description: CTIS id of this organisation-address pairing.

isBusinessKeyValidated.description: True when that key has been validated.

address.description: A postal address as CTIS holds it.

addressLine2.description: Second line; empty string rather than null when unused.

isVulnerablePopulationSelected.description: True when the trial enrols a vulnerable population, which triggers extra safeguards under the regulation.

clinicalTrialGroups.description: The subject groups, e.g. 'Patients' or 'Healthy volunteers'.

ageRangeSecondaryIds.description: The finer age bands within those categories.

trialCategory.description: The regulatory category, which decides how much oversight the trial gets.

trialPhase.description: Phase as a CODE, not as text.

isLowIntervention.description: True for a low-intervention trial, which the regulation allows lighter monitoring for.

justificationForTrialCategory.description: Why the sponsor claims that category.

estimatedGlobalEndDate.description: Planned end worldwide, which can be later.

individualParticipantData.description: Whether participant-level data will be shared.

planToShareIPD.description: The sharing commitment, as a code.

planDescription.description: What the sponsor commits to, in words. Decides whether the result can be re-analysed by anyone else.

sourceOfMonetarySupport.description: Who funds the trial. A funder that also makes the product is a competing interest the register states.

protocolInformation.description: The protocol's structure as CTIS records it.

periodDetails.description: The trial's periods -- screening, treatment, follow-up -- with their arms. EMPTY on the measured trial, which means CTIS holds no structured design for it, not that the trial has no design.

scientificAdviceAndPip.description: Regulatory advice obtained before the trial, and the paediatric plan it falls under.

scientificAdvices.description: Scientific advice the sponsor received from a regulator before filing. An empty list means none is recorded, not that none was sought.

paediatricInvestigationPlan.description: The agreed Paediatric Investigation Plan, where the product has one. A PIP is a binding commitment to study the product in children, so its absence on a trial of an adult indication is expected and its presence is not.

references.description: Publications the sponsor cited for the trial. Empty on the measured trial.

authorizedPartsII.description: Part II, once PER MEMBER STATE. Part II covers the national questions -- sites, investigators, informed consent, recruitment -- and each state decides it separately, so a trial can be authorised in one state and not another.

mscId.description: The member state it belongs to.

recruitmentSubjectCount.description: Subjects to be recruited in THIS state. The Union total is the sum across these entries, not a field of its own.

trialStartDate.description: The trial start date it records.

trialRecruitmentPeriod.description: Every recorded recruitment window, including superseded ones -- 28 entries on the measured trial. The dates CHANGE between entries, so reading an arbitrary one gives an out-of-date window; activeTrialRecruitmentPeriod is the current one.

clinicalTrialStatusHistory.description: Every status this state has given the trial, with the date. This is where a suspension or a restart shows up; `trialStatus` gives only the latest.

id.description: CTIS id of the status row.

trialSites.description: The sites recruiting in this state, with the principal investigator at each. This is the only place the actual hospitals and investigators appear.

departmentName.description: The department, often prefixed with the sponsor's site number, e.g. '#3115: Studienzentrum Onkologie Ravensburg'.

id.description: CTIS id of this organisation-address pairing.

isBusinessKeyValidated.description: True when that key has been validated.

address.description: A postal address as CTIS holds it.

addressLine2.description: Second line; empty string rather than null when unused.

country.description: ISO 3166 NUMERIC country code, e.g. 756 for Switzerland -- not the two-letter code.

oneLine.description: The whole address joined into one line.

organisation.description: The organisation itself, as registered in CTIS's organisation registry.

businessKey.description: CTIS's stable organisation key, e.g. 'ORG-100003908'. This, not `id`, is what identifies the same body across trials.

type.description: What kind of body it is, e.g. 'Pharmaceutical company', 'Hospital/Clinic/Other health care facility'.

commercial.description: True when the organisation is commercial. A commercial sponsor of a trial of its own product is the competing interest the register states plainly.

isBusinessKeyValidated.description: True when the business key has been validated. An unvalidated key may not match the same organisation elsewhere.

personInfo.description: The principal investigator at the site.

applicationInfo.description: Every application filed against this trial -- the initial one and each subsequent modification. `type` distinguishes them, and a trial's current state is the result of all of them.

ctNumber.description: The CT number it was filed under.

businessKey.description: CTIS's key for the application, e.g. 'IN-1'.

type.description: What kind of application, e.g. 'INITIAL'. A modification carries a different type.

modScope.description: What a modification changes, e.g. 'PART_II'. A Part II modification is decided by the affected states only.

allPartTwosOutOfScope.description: True when no Part II was in scope for the application.

partI.description: The Part I assessment for this application.

partIIInfo.description: The Part II assessment per member state for this application.

mscInfo.description: This member state's own handling of the trial. Each state concerned assesses Part II and decides SEPARATELY, so these fields can differ between states for the same trial.

id.description: CTIS id of the member-state record.

countryOrganisationId.description: CTIS id of that country's authority.

decision.description: This state's decision, e.g. 'authorized'. A trial authorised in one state may be refused in another.

firstDecisionDate.description: The first decision date for this state, where the decision was later amended.

trialStatus.description: The trial's status in this state, e.g. 'Authorised'.

reportingStatusCode.description: The reporting status code for this state.

applicationTypeMsc.description: Which kind of application this state handled.

isProposedRms.description: True when this state was proposed as Reporting Member State -- the one that leads the Part I assessment for the whole Union.

isWillingAtDayThreeView.description: True when the state declared itself willing to be RMS by day three.

expressDecision.description: Whether the state expressed willingness, e.g. 'willing'.

hasRecruitmentStarted.description: True when recruitment has begun in this state. False with an authorised status means approved but not yet recruiting.

fromDate.description: Start of the period this record describes.

activeTrialPeriod.description: The currently active trial period in this state.

trialStartDate.description: When the trial actually started in this state.

activeTrialRecruitmentPeriod.description: The currently active recruitment window in this state.

recruitmentEndDate.description: When it closed, or is expected to.

trialPeriod.description: Every recorded trial period for this state, including superseded ones. The newest is mirrored in activeTrialPeriod.

trialStartDate.description: The trial start date it records.

trialRecruitmentPeriod.description: Every recorded recruitment window, including superseded ones -- 28 entries on the measured trial. The dates CHANGE between entries, so reading an arbitrary one gives an out-of-date window; activeTrialRecruitmentPeriod is the current one.

clinicalTrialStatusHistory.description: Every status this state has given the trial, with the date. This is where a suspension or a restart shows up; `trialStatus` gives only the latest.

id.description: CTIS id of the status row.

decisions.description: One decision per member state for this application. They can differ, and they can be dated days apart.

eventType.description: What kind of event the row records, e.g. 'decision'.

isRMS.description: True when that state is the Reporting Member State, whose assessment the others rely on for Part I.

ctMSCsByApplication.description: The member states this application was filed in.

productRoleGroupDocument.description: Documents attached to a product-role group.
